He shifts his posture between shots as camera shutter sound effects are heard. (3) The man walks outdoors at twilight wearing a dark olive green Adidas shirt. (7) In a restaurant with wooden decor, the man sits before a large platter of braised meats and a bowl of soup, speaking directly to the camera while eating. (9) A series of quick cuts show the man chopping tofu, boiling ginger in a pot, and frying sliced onions with dried shrimp in a black pan. (10) The woman sits at a wooden table with a large pot of soup and a bowl of noodles, clasping her hands in thanks before she begins eating and talking with the man.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) Mid-pitch male voice speaks in a conversational tone. Background is quiet with light ambient room tone. (2) A sharp camera shutter 'click' sound effect triggers a transition. An upbeat pop-acoustic guitar BGM begins playing at a moderate tempo. (3) A distinct transition 'whoosh' sound occurs. The male voice becomes louder and more energetic as he walks outdoors, with faint wind noise in the background. (4) The rhythmic sound of liquid pouring into a ceramic cup is heard. A soft 'thud' occurs as a banana is placed on a table. The BGM remains steady. (5) Percussive sounds of a shuttlecock being struck and high-pitched sneaker squeaks on a wooden floor dominate the mix. The male voice yells excitedly during play. (6) The metallic 'clinking' of tongs against a metal tray is clearly audible. Low-level chatter from a crowd creates an ambient restaurant atmosphere. (7) Sounds of slurping and a spoon tapping against a bowl accompany the male voice's narration. The BGM continues with a cheerful melody. (8) A creaking door sound marks a new phase. A female voice speaks with a friendly, relaxed tone. The BGM volume ducks to allow the dialogue to be clear. (9) Rapid, rhythmic 'tock-tock' sounds of a knife on a cutting board are heard. A loud sizzling sound follows as ingredients hit a hot frying pan. (10) The female voice expresses joy through a high-pitched tone and laughter. Soft slurping and blowing sounds are present as she eats. The BGM swells for a final melodic flourish.
